items.title: George Blanchin Interview, 1959-11-13
items.q: I think Sam Morgan, from my memory, had a better band than Buddy.

ctx.x: Actually, I don't think I've ever heard anyone blow any louder than Buddy. He had a tremendous volume to his horn. I've heard better cornet players, I guess, but none that could play any louder. I would say this too, that in Sam Morgan's case, I think Sam Morgan, from my memory, had a better band than Buddy. But he had a pretty rough band, as I recall it. Not smooth at all.
Let me see now. Who else did you mention that you heard over there in those days?
